subject: The Estée Lauder Companies
tool: ConsumerIQ, built with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure OpenAI Service
problem: Teams needed faster access to consumer research across many brands.
workflow: Centralize research; ask questions through a chat interface; follow citations back to original evidence.
result: Microsoft's customer story reports that gathering data went from weeks to minutes.
result_basis: Microsoft customer story with customer testimony; vendor-reported, not an independent benchmark.
measurement_context: Data-gathering time only; no published controlled study, revenue uplift or universal percentage improvement.
source_quote: ELC has reduced the time required to gather data from weeks to minutes.
limitation: Fast retrieval does not establish that an insight is correct or a product will sell; validate the cited source.
listener_action: Suggested small experiment: choose approved research documents, ask one repeatable question, inspect citations, and measure time plus accuracy.
availability: ConsumerIQ is an internal company implementation, not a public consumer app; no claim of current price or general access.
